_comment: Seeded offline 2026-09-14 from documented packaging patterns (vendored yt-competitive-analysis skill + radar format taxonomy). watch_reference points at the pattern source, not a specific video. Replace/augment with radar-extracted formats after the first live scan (G1).

formats.name: Dark-facts 3-item listicle
beats: Stakes: name the situation where the viewer is vulnerable
Mechanism: reveal the 3 items with one-line explanations
Payoff: give the counter-move or memorable takeaway
formats.visual_payoff: Each item appears as bold on-screen text over a matching dramatic clip
formats.notes: Seeded offline from documented listicle pattern; validate against radar outliers after G1

formats.name: Contrarian stop-doing-X
beats: Stakes: call out the common behavior that silently backfires
Mechanism: explain why it fails and what works instead
Payoff: the replacement behavior in one actionable sentence
formats.visual_payoff: Red-X overlay on the wrong behavior, then green-check on the right one
formats.cta_pattern: Try it this week and comment your result
formats.notes: From documented shorts skeleton 'Stop doing X, do Y instead'

formats.name: Year-over-year comparison
beats: Stakes: frame how fast the space moved between two years
Mechanism: 3 side-by-side contrasts, old vs new
Payoff: what the viewer should do differently this year
formats.notes: From documented shorts skeleton '2024 vs 2025 X'

formats.name: Bad-Good-Great tier ranking
beats: Stakes: most people pick the bad option without knowing
Mechanism: rank the 3 tiers with one-line reasons
Payoff: the great option and who it's right for
formats.visual_payoff: Tier labels stamped on screen as each option appears
formats.notes: From documented shorts skeleton 'Bad Good Great X'

formats.name: Myth correction
beats: Stakes: state the widely-believed myth as if true
Mechanism: reveal the evidence that breaks it
Payoff: the correct mental model in one line
formats.visual_payoff: Myth text cracks/shatters at the reveal moment
formats.cta_pattern: Send this to someone who still believes it
formats.notes: From documented 'myth correction' lane in shortform-idea-grill

formats.name: Unsolved-mystery cliffhanger
beats: Stakes: present the historical event with one impossible detail
Mechanism: walk through the 2-3 leading theories
Payoff: the twist evidence, then the open question
formats.visual_payoff: Archival-style imagery with a question mark freeze at the end
formats.notes: Pattern: curiosity-gap story with unresolved ending to drive comments

formats.name: Mind-bending scale comparison
beats: Stakes: anchor with something familiar
Mechanism: zoom through 3 orders of magnitude of comparison
Payoff: the final comparison that reframes the viewer's intuition
formats.visual_payoff: Continuous zoom-out/zoom-in visual with scale counters
formats.notes: Kurzgesagt-style scale revelation adapted to 30s vertical

formats.name: Single-habit money reveal
beats: Stakes: name the habit that quietly drains money
Mechanism: show the math of what it costs per year
Payoff: the one swap that keeps the pleasure and cuts the cost
formats.visual_payoff: Running dollar counter overlay through the middle beat
formats.cta_pattern: Follow for the next habit audit

formats.name: Test-yourself interactive question
beats: Stakes: pose a question the viewer answers in their head
Mechanism: reveal what their answer says about them
Payoff: the nuance most people miss about their own answer
formats.visual_payoff: Question card holds for 3s before the answer reveal
formats.cta_pattern: Comment your answer before watching the end
formats.notes: Pattern: participation hook — comment bait via self-assessment

formats.name: Proof-led tool demo
beats: Stakes: show the tedious task everyone does manually
Mechanism: screen-record the tool doing it in seconds
Payoff: the exact prompt/settings to replicate it
formats.visual_payoff: Real screen capture with the result appearing live
